title: Felstone Field

[[Image:Felstone_Field.jpg|thumb|Felstone Field located in Western Plaguelands.]]

'''Felstone Field''' is located in northwestern [[Western Plaguelands]]. Originally the area was a life-sustaining farm, but it has since been overrun by the vile [[Scourge]]. In their quest to destroy the living, they have placed a large cauldron in the middle of the field which constantly spews disease-filled vapors into the air. The cauldron itself is protected by [[Cauldron Lord Bilemaw]], [[Skeletal Sorcerer|Skeletal Sorcerer]]s, [[Skeletal Flayer|Skeletal Flayers]] and [[Slavering Ghoul]]s.

A [[Scarlet Crusade|Scarlet Crusader]] party has also been detected in Felstone and will destroy both players and Scourge with equal vengeance.

Inside the house in the north eastern corner of the field is a friendly NPC, [[Janice Felstone]], who offers a quest.
